title: Platform routing & auth swimlane — weekly notes Dec 10 2026
content:
Meeting: Platform Routing/Auth swimlane — weekly sync
Date: 2026-12-10
Attendees: Ava, Marcus, Lina, Jonah, Talia (SRE), Dmitri (infra rotator) — scattered short joins
Format: 25m sync + 20m async updates in doc (this file for handoff and sprinting)

1) TL;DR
- Routing slow-path incidents reduced by recent allocator patch, but quota enforcement regressions spotted in canary (PLAT-4821).
- Shortlist for next week: (a) ship auth token cache eviction fix, (b) put soft-fallback for quota quota-check timeout to golden path, (c) finish traffic split automation runbook.
- Blocker: customer-facing quota errors spike on Dedicated when sequence length > 4k; needs infra replay to reproduce.

2) Highlights / quick wins- allocator PR #892 merged (Marcus) — reduces routing table rebuilds on pod churn; expected p50 CPU < 18% for controlplane on medium bursts. Deployed to canary pool yesterday; telemetry looks good for 24h.
- Lina's auth-cache prototype reduced external KMS calls for token validation by ~72% in local benchmarks. Still needs TTL tuning and resilience test for HSM failover.

3) Incidents and signals- 2026-12-09 04:12 UTC: quota-check timeout -> 504 surfaced to some Dedicated customers (region: us-east-1). Root cause still under investigation: apparent linked to KV-store compaction/gc spike during heavy embedding churn. Related ticket: PLAT-4821.
- Metrics on incident: quota-check latency p95 rose from 60ms -> 900ms for ~18 minutes; error budget hit ~0.9% for affected routes.
- Immediate mitigation: roll back new compaction policy to previous settings and reroute small fraction of traffic to fallback rate-limiter (manual) — Dmitri did hotfix at 04:31 UTC.

4) Action items (owners and deadlines)
- Marcus: run full replay for Dedicated customer X profile (seq 4096, batch 8) in staging — reproduce and attach flamegraph to PLAT-4821. Due: 2026-12-13.
- Lina: increment auth-cache TTL experiment and add telemetry for stale-token eviction events; add HSM failover scenario to integration test harness. Due: 2026-12-15.
- Jonah: implement quota soft-fallback (route goes to degraded path returning cached allowance) — design doc stub created in /confluence/PLAT/quota-fallback. Due: 2026-12-17.
- Ava: complete traffic-split automation runbook for canary->prod promotion (include checklist and rollback markers). Due: 2026-12-14.
- Talia (SRE): schedule KV-store compaction window and validate compaction backoff knobs with infra team. Due: 2026-12-12.

5) Roadmap notes / planning signals- Next sprint focus (two-week): stabilize quota checks under high-memory embedding churn, integrate auth-cache into private deployments (config flag), and add end-to-end test for routing failover across regions.
- Consider introducing a small LRU tier in quota-check service to cut repeated RSA ops for deny-heavy patterns (brainstormed by Marcus). Pros: lower p95; cons: additional cache invalidation complexity and correctness risk. Put on backlog for spike.

6) Technical deep-dive snippets (notes-to-self / messy)- allocator change: switch from eager route-table rebuild to diffed incremental apply. observed: rebuilds were thrashing when n_pods fluctuates ~10-20% in 60s windows. Diff apply reduces lock contention but needs careful idempotency on timestamped entries. Watch for subtle race: node with stale heartbeat might reintroduce retired route.
- auth-cache: design sketch — per-tenant local cache with lease TTL (default 30s), eviction-on-key-rotation signal from key-manager stream. Need to ensure multi-region key rotations propagate within 2s window else risk stale accept.

7) Blockers / help needed
- Need infra support to schedule a controlled compaction in prod-like staging. Dmitri / infra-allocator coordination required.
- Security: KMS/HSM team must confirm whether we can relax token validation to allow cached short-lived tokens for private deployments (ask: Lina to open follow-up with sec).

8) Follow-ups and desk items
- Create a small checklist for SRE on how to flip quota soft-fallback in emergency (one-liner CLI + runbook link). Jonah to draft.
- Link to customer-reported trace (redacted) posted in PLAT-ops Slack — add to PLAT-4821.

9) Parking lot / deferred ideas- Evaluate moving default quota-check to async tokens for high-throughput customers (bigger design, depends on SLA/contract changes).
- Explore admission controller upstream patches to reduce pod churn during rolling upgrades.

10) Meeting notes log / micro-updates (quick timeline)
- 2026-12-08: allocator prototype rolled into canary cluster.
- 2026-12-09 04:12 UTC: quota-check timeout incident -> hotfix applied 04:31 UTC. Postmortem notes being collated.
- 2026-12-09 16:00 UTC: auth-cache integration tests passed locally, failing one test in k8s e2e (race on secret rotation).

11) Useful refs / links (placeholders)
- Jira: PLAT-4821 (quota timeout), PLAT-4798 (allocator stability), PLAT-4835 (auth-cache integration)
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/allocator/pull/892 (merged), github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/410 (wip)
- Slack: #pltfm-routing, #sre-oncall (bookmark)

Notes: this doc is the working artifact for handoff to next oncall rotation. Keep it informal, update freely. If you make a change that affects canary behavior, please add a one-line summary with timestamp.

Quick edits log:
- 2026-12-10 09:12 AVA: added action items and consolidated incident timeline.
- 2026-12-11 07:48 MARCUS: merged allocator notes and linked PR.
